name: Ondřej Kolář - § 2 - Am 11
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 2. Rejects the European Council’s decision to open accession negotiations with Bosnia and Herzegovina; considers that the decision to open accession negotiations is essentially a strategic decision in response to Russia’s war against Ukraine; considers that pre-accession aid will only put a further drain on the resources of the EU and its Member States and that the EU integration of Bosnia and Herzegovina will lead to additional political, institutional and financial problems in the EU, also fostering corruption; pleads instead for a geostrategic alignment of foreign, economic and development policy to counter the influence of various foreign actors in Bosnia and Herzegovina and for a mutually beneficial economic partnership, focusing on infrastructure and trade;
